categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three main business segments: proprietary software products (including foundational software like the Shentong database and industrial software such as AVIDM), information technology services (covering audit informatization, commercial secret cloud services, and IT operation and maintenance), and information system integration mainly serving aerospace and government/military sectors. It is a leading software and IT service provider in China's aerospace and government/military fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include ASP+ platform technology, database management systems, embedded real-time operating systems, 3D collaborative design and technical status management, system engineering-based complex project management, data task workflow orchestration and security management, and large-scale aerospace and government/military application software development. The company emphasizes independent R&D with full intellectual property rights, focusing on AI-enabled intelligent tools, digital twin and model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and high-reliability, secure software products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are concentrated in aerospace and government/military sectors, including aerospace military-industrial central enterprises, national ministries, and provincial and municipal government departments. The company supports major national aerospace projects such as Mars exploration, lunar exploration, the Chinese manned space station, and the BeiDou navigation system, providing software and IT services tailored to these strategic and security-critical fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales and services covering major aerospace and military-industrial enterprises and government entities across regions including North China, East China, Northwest, Southwest, South China, Central China, and Northeast China. Its headquarters and main offices are located in Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and IT service supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and IT services. It acts as a project lead integrator, procuring hardware and third-party software components to deliver comprehensive solutions to end customers in aerospace and government sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include becoming a high-reliability common software product provider and a nearby digital transformation service provider. R&D focuses on advancing the ASP+ platform, industrial software (AVIDM, AVPLM), database products (Shentong database series), AI-enabled intelligent tools, digital twin and MBSE technologies, and secure cloud infrastructure. The company actively participates in national key technology projects and emphasizes innovation platform and mechanism construction, intellectual property management, and AI technology integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of standardized software products (e.g., databases), project-based delivery of industrial software, audit informatization services, IT operation and maintenance services, and comprehensive information system integration projects. The company secures contracts mainly via bidding and competitive negotiation, serving aerospace and government/military clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in aerospace and government/military software and IT services, with a strong brand backed by the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation and the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission. It competes with domestic and international software firms but holds unique advantages in secure, high-reliability software for strategic aerospace projects. Market share in the broader domestic database market is relatively low but strong in specialized aerospace and government sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.16 billion, a 30.25% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced IT budgets among key customers. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 82 million. Total assets stood at RMB 3.17 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.74 billion. R&D investment increased to 12.69% of revenue, reflecting a strategic emphasis on innovation despite short-term financial pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its mission to develop indigenous software supporting China's aerospace ambitions, offering secure, reliable, and autonomous software products tailored to complex aerospace and government/military needs. Its products support critical national projects with high security and performance requirements, differentiating through deep domain expertise, comprehensive product portfolios, and integration capabilities. The backing of the aerospace brand enhances trust and market credibility.
